text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
'Knowing I shall not return, drawing the 
catalpa bow, 
I inscribe my name among the fallen'—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I was lacking... 
Lacking that very resolve—!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: And that is why I fell one step short...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Every contest must be fought with backs to 
the wall— 
I must engrave that upon my heart. Next 
time, without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I know that... But right now, I still 
cannot forgive 
my own pitiful inadequacy!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Kh. 
...I shall go douse myself in cold water.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I must quell this burning heat and look 
within. 
—Lest I lose sight of the path I must 
tread.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Will you walk this path of carnage with 
me?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Then I entrust the maintenance of my blade 
to you. 
Our enemy now is the 'demon' within 
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I shall cut it down and conquer it—! 
Utterly and completely...!
